description: This file defines the GatewayDiscoveryModel class, which manages the discovery of gateway endpoints using network browsing, handles logging, and maintains a list of discovered gateways with their details. It includes supporting nested structs for debug logs and discovered gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Final class responsible for discovering gateways via network browsing, managing their state, and logging debug info.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DebugLogEntry
classes.description: Struct representing a debug log entry with timestamp and message.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway
classes.description: Struct representing a discovered gateway with various network and identification parameters.

methods.name: setDebugLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug logging, clearing logs if disabled.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts network browsing for gateways across configured domains, initializing Browser objects.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all active browser objects and clears the list of discovered gateways.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Recomputes the list of discovered gateways, tracking added and removed entries, and updates the main gateways list.

methods.name: updateStatusText
methods.description: Updates the status text based on current browser states and whether browsing is active.

methods.name: prettyState
methods.description: Converts NWBrowser.State enum to a human-readable string.

methods.name: appendDebugLog
methods.description: Appends a message to the debug log if logging is enabled, maintaining a maximum log size.

methods.name: prettifyInstanceName
methods.description: Normalizes and cleans up an instance name string for display.

methods.name: txtValue
methods.description: Fetches a trimmed string value from a dictionary for a given key.

methods.name: txtIntValue
methods.description: Parses an integer from a string value in a dictionary for a given key.

methods.name: txtBoolValue
methods.description: Parses a boolean value from a string in a dictionary for a given key.
